build_async_maskrcnn_detector: build a MaskRCNNDetector with a model config path and optional CUDA device for async inference
init_async_streamqueue: initialize the async CUDA stream queue for the MaskRCNNDetector with a configurable number of streams
test_async_inference: test async Mask R-CNN inference on an image using the MaskRCNNDetector apredict method
run_async_predict: run async prediction on an image path or numpy array using the MaskRCNNDetector apredict method
review_asynctestcase_timeout: review the AsyncTestCase class that configures asyncio test timeouts and coroutine execution
